part_name: 2N5088/2N5089 (Motorola small-signal NPN, TO-92) - PROXY for the NPN small-signal class, not a project part
obtained_by: AI agent (Claude Sonnet 5.5, sourcing agent, L44) on behalf of roberto.carmeli@gmail.com
obtained_from: https://web.mit.edu/6.301/www/2N5089o.pdf (MIT 6.301 course copy of the Motorola sheet). A copy, not the manufacturer host. Byte-for-byte as served.
license_notes: Historic manufacturer datasheet kept unmodified for engineering traceability; copyright remains the original owner.
why_this_part: Only published frequency-resolved noise-current curves found for a small-signal NPN at several collector currents. Class limit only: 2N5089 is an ultra-high-gain (hFE 400-1800) low-noise type, not the 2N5551/MMBT5551 die.

noise_evidence.where: PDF page 3, 'NOISE CHARACTERISTICS', Figure 2 (en vs f), Figure 4 (in vs f; panel labelled 'RS ~ 0' on the page, which is inconsistent with a noise-current plot, likely a printing error), Figure 3 (en vs Ic at fixed f), Figures 5-7 (NF).
noise_evidence.conditions: Vce = 5 V, TA = 25 C, bandwidth 1 Hz, Ic = 10, 30, 100, 300 uA, 1, 3, 10 mA; f = 10 Hz .. 100 kHz

figure_4_noise_current_pA_per_rtHz_coars.minimum_of_each_curve: 1 mA about 0.95 pA near 3 kHz; 300 uA about 0.5 pA near 3-5 kHz; 10 uA about 0.1 pA near 3 kHz
figure_4_noise_current_pA_per_rtHz_coars.1mA_3mA_10mA_low_frequency: NOT RESOLVED: the three top curves leave the 10 pA gridline at the left edge and I could not assign them reliably.

derived_by_agent_not_published.assumed_hFE: 500 for the 10 uA point (datasheet minimum hFE 400-450 for 2N5089)

what_was_not_verified: Not the project's die. hFE assumed. Curve-to-current assignment at the top-left of Figure 4 unresolved.
